testcase.name: Saved(restartRequired) and Rejected(reason, detail) from config-write()
over the real parse, an ok reply maps to Saved and a returned error to Rejected()
writeSetting maps a bare daemon ok=false to Rejected and DaemonUnavailable to Unavailable()
clearSetting sends config-write with NO value key and maps daemon ok=true to Saved()
writeSetting sends config-write with path segments and value, and maps daemon ok=true to Saved()
